title: In JetBrains PhpStorm before 2026.3 project files could be automatically uploaded to a deployment server from…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains PhpStorm before version 2026.3 allows project files to be automatically uploaded to a deployment server from untrusted projects. This behavior could lead to unintended information disclosure or modification. The issue has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.4.
